notes.title: Mythargia release on Nintendo Switch.
notes.notes:
Is this cool or what! We release Mythargia now for Nintendo Switch!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738637/636e3fc3b89723ee3929ce17c3c5eb19e48d88ed.png

Lapland, Finland - May 31st, 2023 - Spine-chilling retro adventure Mythargia release on Nintendo Switch. Prepare to embark on a spine-chilling retro adventure, as you uncover the mysteries of a mysterious abandoned island across two dimensions.

In Mythargia, you assume the role of a courageous journalist searching for the story of a lifetime. Explore the eerie island, solve challenging puzzles, and collect vital clues to piece together the dark history that haunts Mythargia. With atmospheric pixel art and haunting music, the game brings vintage 2D tricks into the Nintendo Switch.

Experience a unique storytelling journey as you cross the boundaries between dimensions, assisting islanders and unraveling their secrets. Beware of the dangers lurking in the shadows, as the island's supernatural beings and treacherous traps pose a constant threat to your survival.

Mythargia has captivated critics with its spine-chilling narrative and innovative blend of vintage aesthetics and modern gameplay. Now, Nintendo Switch players can immerse themselves in the gripping world of Mythargia, uncovering its mysteries and forging their path to the truth.

Features and gameplay in a nutshell:


 Travel between two dimensions to unlock the full story of the island.
 Unravel the dark and disturbing history behind abandoned island of Mythargia. 
 Face otherworldly beings as you navigate the island.
 Search for clues, read journals, and take photos to piece together the story of Mythargia.
 Haunting and spine-chilling story that will keep you engaged from start to finish.


Get ready to embark on an unforgettable adventure when Mythargia releases on Nintendo Switch on May 31st, 2023. Visit the Nintendo eShop to embark on this hair-raising journey.

The game is developed by RunByCoffee, and published by Bonus Stage Publishing. 


Nintendo eShop: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/mythargia-switch/

Press kit: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1d2rvAZ2GDd7Yvwp1r-eih2LFKieCzprX

For press inquiries and review keys, please contact: team@bonusstage.co

notes.title: Mythargia Update - Version: 1.2.0
notes.notes:
We have made a number of improvements to the game's text, including:

 Fixing grammatical errors.
 Improving the readability of the text.
 Adding more detail and flavor to the text content

Steam Deck:

 Clear text popup enabled by default: A larger font with a black background is now enabled by default for Steam Deck users.

Bug fixes:

 Fixed a bug in the Nightmare Mausoleum torch puzzle. Torches now stay lit after leaving and returning to the map if the puzzle is solved.
 Players can no longer interact with torches in the Nightmare Mausoleum after the puzzle is solved
 Fixed a bug in the Vitali puzzle. Torches now stay lit after leaving and returning to the map if the puzzle is solved.
 Fixed bug in which Odd Flower photo would not show correctly in Photo Album's Town tab
 Fixed bug in which Vitali would not appear properly in idle state after teleporting out of the nightmare without talking to Vitali and coming back to the nightmare
 Removed alternative text view prompt when inspecting church chalice
 Fixed a bug where pressing X opened the debug screen

Thank you all for your feedback and for your continued support!

notes.title: Mythargia Update - Version: 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Whew, it's one week after the release and the game is still working. This has been a memorable week for us. We asked you to report to us if you find bugs in the game. And just a note: THE BEAR TRAPS ARE A FEATURE, NOT A BUG.

Nevertheless, here's everything we have already fixed in this patch.


New stuff added
 New: Added "Point of No Return" sign to the sanitarium basement 2 evacuation door
 New: Added "alternative text" feature to character dialogues
 New: Native Linux support
 New: Randomly generated and placed bear traps (may be a joke, dunno...)

Tweaks to audio
 Audio fixes: Locker Room - Void - Level Inspecting file cabinet now gives journal entry sound 
 Audio fixes: Medical Ward - Room 4 - Writing journal entry plays writing audio only once
 Audio fixes: Meeting Rooms - Room 2 - Writing journal entry now plays writing audio only once
 Audio fixes: You should not yell at your mom when the bear traps get you. Focus!

Text updates
 Text fixes: Administrator's Office - Added missing sentence to alternative text prompt

Minor fixes
 Interaction fixes: Library - Fixed barred door's interaction icon location

Damn bugs
 Bug fixes: Articles Tab - The Islanders content 1 photo is now working when obtaining correct photo
 Bug fixes: Articles Tab - The Outsiders content 1 photo is now working when obtaining correct photo 
 Bug fixes: "Paparazzi" achievement fixed
 Bug fixes: Opening "pause menu" while hiding would allow player to start moving around map as invisible character
 Bug fixes: After map change flashlight would revert back to "normal state" even if player had UV mode enabled
 Bug fixes: After map change flashlight mode required to press "flashlight special button" twice

Some changes 
 Changes: You can now open "pause menu" while in hiding or climbing ladders
 Changes: If player is middle of teleporting to new a map or talking to NPC enemies will temporary freeze
 - Changes: Added extra achievements checks each time player opens "Character Menu"


Have fun! We love you all.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2022470/Mythargia/
